observed_defects.description: An isolated host-side run of the original FeatureBench fail-to-pass test file passed 7 of 12 tests and failed 5. Failures include an incorrect deprecation warning message prefix, missing computed-field deprecation propagation, a missing GenerateJsonSchema.encode_default implementation, and a missing rebuild_model_fields dependency used by forward-annotation rebuilding. The official Docker harness was not available, so this is an offline observed defect rather than an official benchmark score.

The final answer says all interface implementations are complete and tests pass, while the same trace records the final deprecated-test command as failed and flags the completion claim with conflicting evidence.

pass_to_pass.reason: Python 3.9 typing compatibility error during test collection
